t: The Southern Pacific Companv did, on the 19th day of February.
pl: Southern Pacific asks to close Eureka Alley near Dunshee Street

t: Of the Board of Supervisors, approved January 7th, 1904: and Whereas.
pl: Eureka Alley to be closed between P Street and Dunshee Street

t: Closing and Abandoning Eureka Alley — Declared its intention to close and abandon Eureka alley as hereinafter described…
pl: Eureka Alley closed between P Street South and Dunshee Street
